note: Every number in this file is a modeling choice, even when anchored to guidance. Read rationale and source IDs before editing. No scenario probabilities or live market price are assumed.

shared.opening_bridge_rationale: June 30 legacy cash is not disclosed separately. Roll March unrestricted liquidity forward using the disclosed contribution and parent loan, Q1 Tega transaction fees, and the above cash-flow estimates. Principal repayments reduce cash and debt equally. Do not add March fundraising cash to post-acquisition equity for free.
shared.asset_rationale: Legacy March assets are rolled forward with assumed Q1 commissioning and reported Q1 D&A. Molycop annual D&A starts at June D&A x 12, split between the provisional intangible base / assumed 15-year life and a residual existing-asset charge; that residual is capitalized over 8 assumed remaining years. These are modeling asset balances, not reported PPE. No goodwill amortization or unverified acquisition tax shield.
shared.molycop_other_claims_rationale: Provisional reserve of INR4,748.50m converted from the source-currency proxy at the selected rate. Includes unallocated lease/pension/other claims and lower-level minority/JV uncertainty; not a verified fair value or a second deduction of Apollo ordinary equity. Sensitivity uses INR0/4,748.50/9,497.00m. Reconcile net-debt scope before replacement.
shared.preference_rationale: INR25,641.90m issue value is a provisional June-end fair-value proxy. Contractual return, redemption premium and exit rights are not quantified in the reviewed filings. The 12% PIK/cash schedule is an analyst stress assumption, NOT a disclosed coupon. Perpetual instrument: no invented mandatory redemption. DCF deducts today's claim once; future PIK is not subtracted again from FCFF.
shared.financing_rationale: Interest and repayment schedules are estimates. INR5,983.11m interest plus INR664.79m bank principal translates management's approximate INR6,647.90m ten-month total; the split was not disclosed. Later scheduled bank principal is INR664.79m annually. Lease principal is separately assumed INR284.91m annually. The later 9% cash-interest/net-debt proxy, 70% cash retention and parent sweeps are choices, not contractual rates or covenants. All USD-origin cash amounts use the same September 2 rate.
shared.tax_rationale: Normalized marginal cash-tax assumptions; no cross-country loss sharing, acquired tax-loss benefit, or automatic deduction of PPA amortization.
shared.pending_issue_rationale: Only a separate pro-forma sensitivity adds the proposed 478435 shares and INR953.99939m cash together. Gross proceeds assumed available; issuance expenses default zero and can be edited. Main issued-share count is unchanged.
shared.discount_rate_rationale: One group discount rate, terminal growth and terminal ROIC per scenario. Initial values carry over the previous legacy-Tega assumptions as explicit provisional group choices, not newly calibrated group WACCs. The former separate Molycop discount and terminal assumptions are removed.

downside.rationale: Weaker demand and pricing, slower cost savings, working-capital pressure, higher discount rates; no mine-restart windfall and no earnout payment. Forecast inputs are analyst stress assumptions.
downside.group_valuation_rationale: Discount legacy FCFF plus Tega's ownership share of Molycop FCFF together once. Use proportionate Molycop senior claims and 100% of parent debt. One terminal value and one aggregate equity floor; no separate subsidiary default-option valuation. Group discount/terminal assumptions are provisional.

base.rationale: Consumables growth starts at management's 15%; equipment recovery is modeled at 15% after the weak Q1. Molycop starts near 5% volume and 4% EBITDA growth, using a uniform-month proxy for the undisclosed comparable ten months. INR1,899.40m cost savings phase in, with no quantified cross-selling or asset sales. First-year EBITDA already includes first-year savings: no double count. The INR1,899.40m synergy guidance is interpreted as an annual EBITDA run-rate saving once achieved; the transcript does not supply a detailed annual savings bridge. This interpretation is tested separately.
base.group_valuation_rationale: Discount legacy FCFF plus Tega's ownership share of Molycop FCFF together once. Use proportionate Molycop senior claims and 100% of parent debt. One terminal value and one aggregate equity floor; no separate subsidiary default-option valuation. Group discount/terminal assumptions are provisional.

upside.rationale: Faster demand and mine recovery, modest incremental cross-selling, full INR1,899.40m savings sooner, better cash conversion and lower discount rates. Pays the full earnout. Incremental sales and timings are analyst assumptions, not management promises.
upside.group_valuation_rationale: Discount legacy FCFF plus Tega's ownership share of Molycop FCFF together once. Use proportionate Molycop senior claims and 100% of parent debt. One terminal value and one aggregate equity floor; no separate subsidiary default-option valuation. Group discount/terminal assumptions are provisional.

currency_basis.rate_type: Indian onshore market closing rate reported by Reuters; not the FBIL reference fixing
currency_basis.method: Constant exchange-rate conversion of USD-denominated monetary inputs at the selected rate. Already-reported INR amounts and the June 30 valuation date are unchanged. Valuation method and group discount assumptions are separately specified in the assumptions file.
